### Binding Decision Cards (1)

Physical or digital card tools that enforce player intent and immersion by requiring explicit, tangible commitment to actions before encountering outcomes, reducing hindsight bias in solo or DM-led play.

### Black Market Magic (1)

A curated collection of illicit, rare, and unstable magical items traded in underground markets—often with hidden curses, unstable properties, or morally ambiguous origins—designed to enrich noir-style urban campaigns and introduce high-risk treasure for daring adventurers.
